Dr. Rowe goes over how to ease sciatica when standing with three EASY exercises.

These exercises can be done at home, are DIY and don't require any equipment. They focus on relieving tension and pressure off the sciatic nerve, giving QUICK RELIEF to sharp leg pain when standing.

They can also be used to help prevent sciatica pain when standing. If you find yourself standing in one spot for long periods of time, you'll not want to miss this one!

Watch now and get some quick sciatica relief!
